summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres addressed the Security Council's first debate on artificial intelligence, urging global governance and oversight. He highlighted AI's unprecedented speed and potential, while warning of risks to peace, security, and human rights. He proposed a new UN entity for AI governance and called for urgent action.

claims.text: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just two months.
claims.evidence_quote: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just two months.

claims.text: AI could contribute between $10 and $15 trillion to the global economy by 2030.
claims.evidence_quote: AI could contribute between $10 and $15 trillion to the global economy by 2030.

claims.text: The UN Secretary-General called for a legally binding instrument to prohibit lethal autonomous weapons systems by 2026.
claims.evidence_quote: The Policy Brief on a New Agenda for Peace will also call for negotiations to be concluded by 2026 on a legally binding instrument to prohibit lethal autonomous weapons systems that function without human control or oversight

claims.text: Guterres announced he is convening a High-Level Advisory Board for AI that will report on global AI governance options by the end of this year.
claims.evidence_quote: I am convening a multistakeholder High-Level Advisory Board for Artificial Intelligence that will report back on the options for global AI governance, by the end of this year.

claims.text: AI-enabled cyberattacks are already targeting critical infrastructure and UN peacekeeping and humanitarian operations.
claims.evidence_quote: AI-enabled cyberattacks are already targeting critical infrastructure and our own peacekeeping and humanitarian operations, causing great human suffering.

claims.text: Guterres warned that the interaction between AI and nuclear weapons, biotechnology, neurotechnology, and robotics is deeply alarming.
claims.evidence_quote: the interaction between AI and nuclear weapons, biotechnology, neurotechnology and robotics is deeply alarming.

claims.text: The UN Secretary-General urged that human agency and control are essential for nuclear weapons and should never be withdrawn.
claims.evidence_quote: human agency and control are essential for nuclear weapons and should never be withdrawn.

claims.text: Guterres compared AI's impact to the printing press, but noted it took over 50 years for printed books to become widely available, while ChatGPT reached 100 million users in two months.
claims.evidence_quote: It has been compared to the introduction of the printing press. But, while it took more than 50 years for printed books to become widely available across Europe, ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just two months.

claims.text: The UN Secretary-General stated that AI has the potential to turbocharge global development, from monitoring the climate crisis to breakthroughs in medical research.
claims.evidence_quote: It has the potential to turbocharge global development, from monitoring the climate crisis to breakthroughs in medical research.

claims.text: Guterres noted that the High Commissioner for Human Rights has expressed alarm over evidence that AI can amplify bias, reinforce discrimination, and enable new levels of authoritarian surveillance.
claims.evidence_quote: the High Commissioner for Human Rights has expressed alarm over evidence that AI can amplify bias, reinforce discrimination and enable new levels of authoritarian surveillance.
